tokens.name: jci-blue
tokens.usage: JCI Blue (Pantone 2925 C; CMYK 77/27/0/0). The main brand colour: use prominently for recognisability. Fills, large text (24px+ or bold 19px+) and graphics on white/surface-tint (3.3:1); as text on jci-black it reads at 5.7:1.

tokens.name: jci-black
tokens.usage: JCI Black (Pantone 5395 C; CMYK 100/98/47/66). Text on white, surface-tint, jci-blue, jci-teal and jci-yellow (18.5, 17.5, 5.7, 8.2, 11.1:1), and the dark ground for inverted layouts.

tokens.name: jci-white
tokens.usage: JCI White. Background, and text on jci-black or jci-navy (18.5, 9.0:1). Not for text on jci-teal or jci-yellow (2.3, 1.7:1).

tokens.name: jci-navy
tokens.usage: JCI Navy (Pantone 2728 C; CMYK 96/76/15/3). Secondary. Text on white or jci-yellow (9.0, 5.4:1); with white text on it 9.0:1.

tokens.name: jci-teal
tokens.usage: JCI Teal (Pantone 3265 C; CMYK 63/0/30/0). Secondary accent; put jci-black text on it (8.2:1), jci-navy only for large text (4.0:1).

tokens.name: jci-yellow
tokens.usage: JCI Yellow (Pantone 142 C; CMYK 7/21/93/0). Contrast accent, about 5% of a layout; jci-black text on it (11.1:1).

tokens.name: jci-blue-75
tokens.usage: 75% tint of jci-blue (mixed with white), as printed in the guide. Backgrounds and secondary elements; check text contrast before putting copy on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent-text.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Panels and cards, the pale blue panel of the guide (light: jci-blue at 5%; dark: DERIVED, a jci-black to jci-navy mix, not in the guide). Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent-text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-tint (18.5 and 17.5:1 light; 18.5 and 15.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface and surface-tint (8.4 and 7.9:1 light; 10.6 and 9.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: JCI Blue as an accent fill, icon, rule or large text (3.3:1 on white in light; 5.7 and 4.8:1 on the dark surface and surface-tint). Not for small body text in the light theme: use accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and small accent-coloured text on surface and surface-tint: 9.0 and 8.6:1 light, 10.3 and 8.7:1 dark. The guide sets small labels in jci-blue, which misses 4.5:1 on white; this is the accessible substitute.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent (jci-blue) fill: 5.7:1. White on jci-blue is 3.3:1: only for 24px+ or bold 19px+ text, as in the white logo.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Sparing emphasis (about 5% of a layout). Text on it: on-highlight.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on highlight (11.1:1).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Navy as a fill for secondary blocks and ripple rings; text on it: on-secondary.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on secondary (9.0:1).

tokens.name: support
tokens.usage: Teal as a fill or ripple ring; text on it: on-support.

tokens.name: on-support
tokens.usage: Text on support (8.2:1). Never white (2.3:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Outlines that carry meaning (inputs, the white swatch outline): 3.5:1 on white and 3.3:1 on surface-tint in light; 5.3 and 4.5:1 in dark.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Headlines. Regular; step up to SemiBold/Bold only for extra emphasis.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: Become the change in a changing world

styles.name: paragraph
styles.sample: Our members learn by doing, grow by sharing and lead by acting.

styles.name: location-name
styles.usage: National/local name in a logo lock-up, when the logo is 570px wide; scales with the logo. Set in jci-blue.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Large quotes and callouts in editorial layouts only (press releases, the JCI magazine). Set in jci-blue.

spacing.note: Not defined in the brand guide: a 4px-based scale derived from its layouts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label, small gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default padding and gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large section spacing.

radius.note: Not defined in the brand guide: derived from the rounded panels in its layouts. The logo, ripple and shield are never rounded or altered.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels and image frames.
